title: Soul Snack #41: Psychology – Balancing a Shattered Soul
excerpt: Explore your full potential, so you can give the gifts you were born to give.
bodyHtml:
Explore your full potential, so you can give the gifts you were born to give. Enroll in Soul Themes Today. Your soul has been waiting for you to take this journey!

In this powerful Soul Snack, Gary explores the limitations of traditional psychology and introduces a radically expanded view of healing – one rooted in the soul. He explains why psychology, as it’s typically practiced, cannot fully understand or address the true causes of emotional and behavioral dysfunction. The conversation leads into the spiritual dimensions of healing, karma, and the journey toward authentic power.

Gary shares how our five-sensory perception is giving way to a multisensory awareness – one that sees not just personality, but the soul behind every action and emotion.

This shift reveals that every emotional wound or destructive behavior stems from a fractured connection between the personality and the soul.

What we often diagnose as neurosis or emotional breakdowns are, in fact, signs of a soul struggling to reclaim its wholeness.

The key to integrating a shattered soul lies in creating authentic power: aligning your personality with your soul by choosing love over fear.

Through emotional awareness and responsible choice, we can challenge the frightened parts of our personalities and instead nurture the loving parts that restore balance, harmony, and meaning to our lives.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:
(01:12) – Why psychology as we know it is incomplete without the recognition of the soul
(03:37) – How emotional dysfunction is rooted in karmic experiences and soul fragmentation
(06:00) – What it means to interact with others as souls, not just personalities
(08:45) – Why the behaviors we consider toxic are actually damaging our soul’s energy
(10:02) – How to understand neurosis, psychosis, and breakdowns as symptoms of a shattered soul
(13:55) – A new path forward: how loving choices nourish the soul and reshape the world

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge:

Think of a time when you acted from a frightened part of your personality – perhaps with jealousy, anger, or resentment. What sensations did you feel in your energy processing centers at that moment? What fears were driving your choices? Now consider: what effect might those actions have had on your soul? Take a quiet moment to reflect, breathe, and bring forward the loving parts of your personality – gratitude, compassion, patience. What would it look like to choose those instead, even in difficult moments? This is the beginning of integrating your soul and contributing to a new world.
